sources.title: IT Jungle — Feeding the Auditor: Problem User Profiles

notes: IBM CHGACTPRFL is a CL command (USRPRF + ACTION *ADD/*REMOVE). Lab shows post-change confirmation subfile plus Changed profile detail. Pair with DSPACTPRFL for audit evidence. Communications/FTP-only profiles must be on the list (SecureMyi 2014).
asciiPanel:
CHGACTPRFL                       Change Activity Profile List            CLAIMS400

      Profiles on the activity list are exempt from inactive-profile disable.

      Profile      Activity list status
      BACKUPADM    *ACTIVE

      Changed profile . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . : BACKUPADM

F3=Exit   F12=Cancel
